channel.description: This file is an XML representation of an issue

item.title: [IGNITE-5489] Possible connection leaks when loadPreviousValue set to true
item.description:
When CacheConfiguration#setLoadPreviousValue set to true on owning node does not call CacheStore#sessionEnd method. It can to lead to leak of connections to DB.
See attached test.
item.summary: Possible connection leaks when loadPreviousValue set to true
